method.signal: per-decision GROSS return vector of each ANCHOR (and NEIGH for the ancestry panel) built exactly per the proposal representation_identity on the frozen S4 H1 panels; pooled across the 3 symbols in symbol-major chronological order
method.cost_invariance: r_net = r - 2c with constant c per arm: Pearson is invariant to additive shifts and Spearman to monotone transforms, so every rho below equals the after-cost rho at ANY tier constant; no cost constant invented
method.veto_alignment: hourly vetoes evaluated on the decision bar (closed and PIT at the decision close); daily vetoes dated D = the decision's UTC date (the inherited V17 exposure-vs-proxy convention; level proxies describe the decision-day state)
method.statistics: pooled Pearson + Spearman (average-rank ties); veto bar |rho| > 0.2; margin = bar - max|rho|; pairs need n >= 8 aligned rows and non-zero variance on both sides, else recorded UNMEASURED with a reason (V17 used a 30-pair guard on multi-thousand-point grids; the NG1 frozen D2 series are 12/24 rows by declaration, so the guard is the cycle's own floor of 8; the 0.20 bar is unchanged)
method.pnl_ban: no expectancy, PF, PnL or any aggregate of returns is computed in this artifact; raw return vectors are NOT embedded (reproducible from code + frozen panels)
